issues.issue: beginning_investments is filled in even though the same amount is already part of beginning_cash (line 5), while ending_investments is null. Under the field rules, investments are filled only when reported separately and are not added to cash. A downstream sum of cash + investments would count 32,407.90 twice, and the beginning and ending fields are not treated the same way.

This line is 25.6% of governmental receipts, so 'other' is over the 10% review threshold. Nothing on the form says what it is. For rural fire districts it is often fire-protection contracts with cities or villages (which would be charges for services/fees), but this cannot be confirmed from the page.
Fiscal year end is assumed and not printed in the trimmed PDF.
